title: Microsoft Dynamics Developer
description:
About You

You are a technically strong Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Developer who enjoys building, customizing, and integrating enterprise-grade ERP solutions. You thrive in structured environments, value best practices, and take ownership of delivering reliable, well-documented systems. You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and feel comfortable supporting, maintaining, and evolving complex business applications.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Developer Associate (mandatory and up to date, with annual renewal).
  • Strong experience developing and customizing Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) solutions.
  • Solid understanding of D365 F&O architecture, development lifecycle, and best practices.
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining integrations using Azure Data Factory for ETL and data synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience using Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) for deployment, monitoring, environment management, and maintenance.
  • Ability to collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for production and non-production environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Develop, customize, and maintain Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations applications based on business requirements.
  • Design, build, and support data integrations using Azure Data Factory, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
  • Use Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) to manage deployments, monitor environments, and support application health.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (functional consultants, developers, business users) to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for D365 F&O applications.
  • Document technical designs, configurations, integrations, and operational processes.
  • Support ongoing maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of D365 F&O solutions.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*
  • Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Farmacêutico clínico
description:
Vaga: Farmacêutico de Clínica - Hub de Saúde Méier, RJ.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Garantir as boas práticas farmacêuticas de acordo com as normas, legislações e procedimentos internos.
  • Realizar a assistência farmacêutica aos clientes;
  • Manter organizada e atualizada a documentos técnica da parte de saúde da clínica;
  • Manter impresso, atualizado e multiplicar os colaboradores em relação aos procedimentos operacionais padrão da empresa (POP ́s) e Manual de Boas Práticas (MBPF);
  • Cumprir com os procedimentos internos e legais na realização de serviços farmacêuticos e/ou de imunização humana;
  • Acompanhar os comunicados de recolhimento e verificação de produtos das salas de serviços de saúde, e garantir a retirada destes da área de vendas, bem como a devolução aos Centros de Distribuição (CD);
  • Esclarecer dúvidas técnicas de clientes e demais funcionários de uma loja;
  • Garantir o cumprimento de procedimentos técnico-legais como: armazenamento de produtos e condições de temperatura;
  • Participar de ação extramuros.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Formação superior em Farmácia;
  • Pós Graduação em Farmácia Clínica ou Prescrição Farmacêutica;
  • CRF Ativo;
  • Experiência de 6 meses ou mais atuando em loja com serviço de Vacinação;
  • Certificação em Vacinação, que pode incluir cursos específicos de imunização e aplicação de vacinas;
  • Conhecimento das normas e legislações sanitárias relacionadas à vacinação;
  • Capacidade de realizar triagem clínica e avaliação de contraindicações para vacinação;
  • Boa comunicação para esclarecer dúvidas dos pacientes.

Por que fazer parte do nosso time:

Na DPSP (lojas, CDs e corporativo), nosso trabalho impacta a saúde e o bem-estar de milhões de brasileiros todos os dias. Nossa força está nas pessoas que colocam saúde em primeiro lugar, atuam com ética, colaboração e respeito às diferenças.

Junte-se a nós e seja protagonista na transformação da jornada de saúde de quem confia na gente.

Mais do que igualdade, buscamos equidade: Aqui, temos espaço para sermos autênticos independentemente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, credo ou deficiência.

Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD). #VemSerDPSP

title: Analista de Segurança Física e Corporativa Sr
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Que tal fazer parte de uma das empresas mais inovadoras do Brasil? Estamos em busca de novos talentos para a posição de Analista de Segurança Física e Corporativa Sr, com atuação no Rio de Janeiro. Procuramos alguém que queira integrar um time colaborativo, inovador e orientado ao cliente.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em TI, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, ou áreas correlatas.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Espanhol desejável.
  • Experiência prévia na área de segurança física e da informação.

Atividades

  • Implementar medidas e processos para proteger pessoas (incluindo segurança em viagens), instalações físicas e ativos corporativos.
  • Assegurar que sistemas e controles físicos estejam alinhados aos padrões técnicos e regulatórios.
  • Implementar planos de evacuação e sistemas contra incêndios.
  • Definir e aplicar controles de acesso (crachás, biometria, senhas).
  • Instalar barreiras físicas, sistemas de vigilância (CFTV), alarmes e sensores.
  • Trabalhar de forma holística, integrando segurança física, corporativa e cibernética para reduzir riscos e aumentar a resiliência.
  • Promover a convergência de processos e ferramentas para identificação, avaliação e mitigação de riscos.
  • Identificar riscos relevantes, conduzir análises e definir medidas preventivas.
  • Atuar na detecção, resposta e recuperação de incidentes de segurança física, coordenando ações com equipes técnicas e autoridades quando necessário.
  • Cumprir requisitos legais e regulatórios (ex.: LGPD, normas locais e internacionais).
  • Reportar periodicamente à liderança sobre ameaças, incidentes e status das medidas implementadas.
  • Supervisionar sistemas de segurança, realizar auditorias e propor melhorias.
  • Promover treinamentos periódicos sobre práticas seguras.
  • Criar cultura organizacional voltada para prevenção e resposta a riscos.

Cadastre o seu currículo e boa sorte!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para pessoas com deficiências.

Sobre o Grupo Generali

A Generali é um dos maiores grupos globais de gestão de ativos e seguros. Fundada em 1831, está presente em mais de 50 países ao redor do mundo, com uma receita total de prêmios de 95,2 bilhões de euros em 2024. Com cerca de 87 mil colaboradores e 71 milhões de clientes globalmente, o Grupo ocupa uma posição de liderança na Europa e vem expandindo sua presença na Ásia e na América Latina. A Generali busca ser Parceira Para Toda Vida de seus clientes, oferecendo soluções inovadoras e personalizadas por meio de uma rede de distribuição incomparável.

title: Engenheiro de Capex - Projeto
description:
Engenheiro de Capex - Projetos

Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de Ser a Melhor Empresa de Saneamento PARA o Brasil. Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.

Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs). Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.

Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente!

Local de Atuação: Rio de Janeiro, RJ (Iguá Rio de Janeiro S.A).

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir tecnicamente o desenvolvimento e fiscalização de projetos de água e esgoto, desde a concepção, planejamento e executivo;
  • Estruturar o planejamento financeiro e de obras do Plano de Negócio da empresa.
  • Elaborar e revisar estudos de viabilidade técnica, projetos, cronogramas e relatórios;
  • Garantir a aderência dos projetos às diretrizes técnicas, regulatórias e estratégicas da Iguá;
  • Propor soluções técnicas inovadoras e apoiar na priorização dos investimentos;
  • Dar suporte técnico à liderança na tomada de decisão e no planejamento estratégico;
  • Promover reuniões técnicas com times de engenharia, operações, suprimentos e fornecedores;
  • Interface técnica com áreas internas e externas;
  • Atuar diretamente nos estudos, especificações e contratações de obras e serviços;
  • Elaboração de relatórios, planilhas e apresentações;
  • Orientar e apoiar o desenvolvimento do time.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação em Engenharia Sanitária, Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Civil ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Domínio de QGIS ou ArcGIS;
  • Domínio do AutoCAD;
  • Sólida experiência com estudos, projetos e planejamento de obras de água e esgoto;
  • Conhecimento técnico aplicado em normativas, concepção e projetos executivos e planejamento;
  • Liderança técnica de projetos.

Desejável:

  • Pós-graduação ou especialização na área de saneamento ou infraestrutura;
  • Conhecimento PowerBI e análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento em SewerGEMS e WaterGEMS
  • CNH categoria B definitiva e válida.

title: Network Engineer Commissioning Specialist (BSC/RNC), OSS and Sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.

This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client's technical requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • (Must-have).Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2G/3G/4G/5G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS.
  • Execute configuration, expansion, and technical audit activities on OSS platforms.
  • Support and accompany field activities related to the activation of new sites, swaps, migrations, and network expansions.
  • Ensure correct implementation of parameters, scripts, and integration routines.
  • Monitor network KPIs and alarms, identifying and proactively resolving faults.
  • Prepare technical reports, action plans, and network documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with planning, O&M, and optimization teams to ensure network performance and stability.
  • Provide technical support during maintenance windows and critical activation processes including SWAPs.

Technical Requirements:

  • Proven experience with BSC and/or RNC Controllers (any vendor: ZTE, Ericsson, Nokia, Huawei).
  • Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2G/3G/4G/5G networks.
  • Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
  • Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
  • Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
  • Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
  • Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.

Desired Profile:

  • Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
  • Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
  • Proactive and collaborative attitude.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
  • Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

description:
1. Planejar, coordenar e executar estudos de validação de processos de fabricação. Elaborar protocolos, relatórios e análises críticas para suportar a reprodutibilidade e consistência do processo.

5. Elaborar, revisar e aprovar protocolos, relatórios de validação de envase asséptico e outros documentos técnicos. Garantir a integridade e a rastreabilidade de todos os registros, em conformidade com as exigências regulamentares e padrões internos.

6. Atuar como referência técnica em processos de validação durante auditorias internas e externas, incluindo inspeções de autoridades sanitárias e auditorias de clientes.

7. Participação ativa em investigações de desvios, propondo ações corretivas e preventivas;

8. Elaborar apresentações e treinamentos referentes às atividades sob sua responsabilidade.

9. Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de qualidade, produção, engenharia e desenvolvimento, para a implementação de melhorias contínuas nos processos validados e o suporte técnico necessário em projetos e mudanças.

title: Platform Engineer (AWS)
description:
About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You're looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 4+ years of experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Infrastructure Engineer with focus on developer enablement.
  • Deep expertise in AWS, especially working with services like ECS, IAM, and supporting microservices architectures.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools like Terraform to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipeline orchestration in production environments.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or configuration formats like YAML and JSON for automation.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, ideally using frameworks like Backstage.
  • Strong understanding of Platform as a Service (PaaS) principles and creating self-service tools to streamline developer workflows.
  • Experience developing modular, reusable infrastructure templates to enable scalable and consistent resource provisioning.
  • Familiarity with automatic provisioning logic, such as conditional resource deployment based on developer inputs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills; fluent in English (advanced).

You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Build and evolve the internal developer platform, enabling engineering teams to self-serve infrastructure and deployments efficiently.
  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, ensuring secure, automated delivery across services.
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code modules that enforce best practices and support multi-service deployments at scale.
  • Create reusable infrastructure templates for provisioning environments like ECS, based on dynamic developer inputs.
  • Automate resource provisioning workflows, including conditional logic and default resource allocation.
  • Develop self-service tools and dashboards that reduce support tickets and empower development teams.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the platform by continuously implementing updates and integrating new cloud-native technologies.
  • Collaborate with security and compliance teams to integrate guardrails and standards into platform tooling.
  • Support internal adoption of Backstage or similar developer portal frameworks to centralize resources and documentation.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.

Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*

*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

Descrição do perfil

Responsável por assegurar o desenvolvimento e a gestão das infraestruturas técnicas necessárias para as atividades de cobrança, controlando o processo de cobrança, analisando periodicamente as contas para identificar aquelas que podem requerer procedimentos de cobrança especiais e atuando também nos processos de governança que envolvem a cadeia de cobrança.

  • Analisar reclamações ANATEL, sobre as ações de cobrança, com o objetivo de identificar as oportunidades sobre os processos sistêmico da cadeia, garantindo a melhoria contínua e redução do índice de reclamações de Cobrança na ANATEL;

  • Desenvolver relatórios que possibilitem o melhor controle da cadeia de cobrança;

  • Elaborar apresentações executivas;

  • Gerar insights com base nos dados coletados para melhoria contínua;
  • Criar dashboards e relatórios periódicos para acompanhamento de performance.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties:

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.


Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.Js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.


Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.
  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.G., Kafka), and feature flag management.

title: Platform Engineer
description:

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

  • Drive initiatives to reduce manual operations and increase developer velocity through automation and platform reliability.

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: International Buyer
description:
General Description


The Buyer will be responsible for sourcing, purchasing, and assisting in the management of the inventory for the landing gear MRO operations. This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.


Detailed Description


Procurement of Materials & Parts:

  • Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
  • Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
  • Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.G., FAA, EASA).


Inventory Management:

  • Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
  • Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.


Supplier Relationship Management:

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
  • Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.


Quality Assurance & Compliance:

  • Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
  • Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.


Data Entry & Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
  • Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.


Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:

  • Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
  • Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.


Cost Control:

  • Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.


Qualification Minimum Requirements


Work Experience:

At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.

Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage


Educational:

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.

Fluent/advanced English


Technical Skills:

Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).

Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)


Soft Skills:

Strong negotiation and communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Network Engineer Commissioning Specialist (Bsc/Rnc), Oss And Sites
description:

Desired Profile:

Job Title: Head of Sales (Sales Manager)

Department: Sales

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Location: Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Brazil

Employment Type: Full-Time, CLT ou PJ


Role Overview


We are looking for a hands-on, results-driven Head of Sales to lead and scale our commercial operations in Brazil. This is both a strategic and operational role, ideal for someone who can design sales strategies and execute them personally.

You will be working in a startup environment, not a corporate structure. This means high autonomy, fast decision-making, direct customer contact, and the flexibility to step outside your job title when needed. In addition to defining the sales strategy, you will be actively involved in prospecting, client visits, negotiations, and closing deals.

This role is critical to the company’s growth. You will have a direct impact on revenue generation, team building, and the development of scalable sales processes as the company expands.


Key Responsibilities


Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth
  • Develop, implement, and continuously optimize clear, measurable sales strategies
  • Define priorities by region, product, and customer segment
  • Actively drive revenue through calls, on-site visits, and negotiations
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities
  • Adapt strategies quickly based on real-world market feedback


Field Sales Execution
  • Personally visit clients and prospects when required
  • Open new accounts through cold outreach and door-to-door visits
  • Support and close strategic and high-value negotiations
  • Represent the company professionally in the field


Team Leadership & Coordination
  • Coordinate daily with internal sales reps, freelancers, and partners

  • Train, motivate, and hold the team accountable for results


CRM, Processes & Reporting
  • Work in a structured manner with the CRM system (HubSpot is essential)

  • Report results, forecasts, and action plans to management
  • Ensure sales activities align with operational and logistical capacity


Startup & Operational Support
  • Operate effectively in a fast-paced startup with changing priorities
  • Understand core operational and logistical processes to support sales execution
  • Support operations when needed to remove bottlenecks
  • Collaborate closely with finance, operations, and marketing teams
  • Contribute to improving internal processes as the company scales


Requirements


Must-Have
  • Proven experience as a Head of Sales, Sales Manager, or senior B2B sales professional
  • Strong ability to build and execute sales strategies
  • Comfortable with frequent calling and door-to-door sales
  • Highly results-driven and accountable
  • Flexible mindset suited to a startup environment
  • Fluent Portuguese and good English skills
  • Solid CRM and pipeline management experience (HubSpot is essential )


Nice-to-Have
  • Experience in horeca, wholesale, FMCG, or food & beverage
  • Experience in early-stage or scaling companies


Compensation & Rewards
  • Competitive base salary
  • Strong performance-based bonus structure
  • Clear and direct link between results and compensation
  • Long-term growth opportunities as the company scales


Who This Role Is For

This role is for someone who:

  • Thrives in a startup environment
  • Is flexible, hands-on, and solution-oriented
  • Builds strategies and executes them personally
  • Is motivated by performance-based rewards
  • Takes full ownership of sales performance and outcomes

title: Tax Coordinator
description:
The Regional Tax Coordinator will support the global tax function with end‑to‑end ownership of multi‑jurisdiction tax compliance, controversy, and operational readiness. The role encompasses direct and indirect taxes, withholding tax and treaty management, transfer pricing oversight, and implementation of new global regimes such as Pillar Two.

The coordinator will drive strategic tax planning initiatives that optimize the effective tax rate and cash taxes while ensuring robust compliance, operational substance, and scalable controls and automation. This position partners closely with finance, controllership, treasury, legal, and business teams to support new transactions, products, and market entries and to proactively assess permanent establishment and nexus risks.


RESPONSABILITIES

i. Ensures timely and accurate tax compliance across all in‑scope jurisdictions, including corporate income taxes, indirect taxes such as VAT, GST, ICMS, and ISS, and withholding tax returns and information reporting.

ii. The role owns the global tax calendar and filing controls, establishing standard operating procedures and clear accountabilities to maintain a consistently high on time filing rate and audit readiness.

iii. Map tax opportunities and risks, proposing and implementing tax planning initiatives and corporate restructurings aimed at tax efficiency and reduction of the overall tax burden.

iv. Act in a consultative capacity with business areas, treasury, and controllership, providing support on tax-related matters and new transactions.

v. Monitor changes in local and international tax legislation and ensure the implementation of internal improvements to comply with new regulations.

vi. Lead internal and external tax audits and inspections with authorities in Brazil and other jurisdictions, managing controversy strategies and external advisors to achieve efficient, defensible outcomes.

vii. Analyze due diligence reports and provide support for strategic projects, such as the development of new products and M&A transactions.

viii. Develop and monitor robust internal controls to mitigate tax risks.

ix. Prepare reports and documentation to support senior management in tax-related matters.


QUALIFICATIONS

i. Bachelor’s degree in accounting, law or related area

ii. Minimum 8 years of experience, (Big 4 or public company experience preferred)

iii. Language: English, advanced / Spanish, desirable


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

i. Strong knowledge of global tax laws, cross-border regulations, and transfer pricing principles.

ii. Proficiency with tax preparation software and ERP.

iii. Experience with Financial institutions is desirable


SOFT SKILLS

i. Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

ii. Effective planning and priority setting

iii. Must be well organized and detail-oriented

iv. Teamwork

v. Clear and effective written and verbal communication

vi. Interpersonal and presentation skills

vii. Analytical skills

title: Designer De Roupas
description:
Design de Produto (moda athleisure)

I. A Missão da Posição

O Especialista de Design (Lifestyle) é o responsável estratégico por traduzir conceitos e ideias criativas em produtos técnicos viáveis e desejáveis. Atuando como o braço técnico da área de Estilo, sua missão é transformar os direcionamentos estéticos em especificações precisas, garantindo que a identidade da marca de Athleisure seja preservada desde o desenho inicial até o produto acabado. Ele atua como uma referência técnica, assegurando que cada peça de vestuário combine inovação estética com rigor funcional e comercial.


II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Tradução e Desenvolvimento Técnico: Converter conceitos criativos e temas propostos pelo Estilista em desenhos técnicos, modelagens e acabamentos detalhados para as coleções.
  • Pesquisa Aplicada de Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de materiais e referências de mercado para viabilizar tecnicamente as tendências e comportamentos de consumo identificados.
  • Acompanhamento de Prototipagem: Atuar em parceria direta com as áreas de Produto, Modelagem e Sourcing, acompanhando ajustes, amostras e validações técnicas até a aprovação final das peças.
  • Interface de Viabilidade: Trabalhar de forma integrada com Comercial, Marketing e Produção para garantir que a tradução do design respeite a viabilidade técnica e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Guardião da Consistência Criativa: Zelar pela qualidade técnica e consistência estética das coleções, garantindo que o produto final reflita fielmente a identidade visual da marca.
  • Ajuste de Performance: Utilizar feedbacks de mercado e análises de performance das coleções para aplicar melhorias técnicas contínuas no desenvolvimento de novos produtos.


III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada em design de produto ou posições técnicas em moda, com foco em sportswear ou athleisure.
  • Domínio Técnico Avançado: Profundo conhecimento em processos de desenvolvimento, construção de vestuário, materiais tecnológicos e leitura/execução de fichas técnicas detalhadas.
  • Vivência em Suprimentos: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e relacionamento técnico com fornecedores.
  • Habilidades de Tradução Criativa: Capacidade de converter conceitos abstratos em soluções de design comerciais e funcionais com rigor estético.
  • Formação: Graduação em Moda, Design de Moda, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.


IV. Diferenciais

  • Experiência em traduzir coleções de alta escala e múltiplas entradas sazonais.
  • Vivência em marcas de moda lifestyle que exijam alto nível de detalhamento técnico.
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica dentro do time de estilo para viabilização de novos produtos.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados de performance de produto para otimização do design.

title: Encarregado De Laboratório (Solos, Concreto E Asfalto)
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Encarregado de Laboratório para atuar no controle tecnológico de obras, garantindo a qualidade e confiabilidade dos ensaios em solos, concreto e asfalto , conforme normas técnicas vigentes.


Principais Atividades


  • Coordenar e supervisionar a equipe de laboratório e campo;
  • Planejar, executar e validar ensaios de solos, concreto e asfalto;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas técnicas (ABNT / DNIT / DNER);
  • Acompanhar resultados, elaborar relatórios e apoiar a engenharia;
  • Zelar pela calibração, conservação dos equipamentos e organização do laboratório.

Experiência com Ensaios

Solos: granulometria, limites de Atterberg, umidade (Speedy e fogareiro), compactação (Proctor), CBR/ISC, equivalente de areia, massa específica “in situ”.

Asfalto: Marshall (Estabilidade e Fluência), teor de betume, granulometria, densidade aparente, viscosidade Saybolt Furol, ponto de amolecimento, penetração, ductilidade, extração de testemunhos.

Concreto: moldagem e rompimento de corpos de prova, slump test, teor de ar, compressão, tração na flexão, módulo de elasticidade.


Requisitos


  • Formação técnica ou superior em áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em laboratório de solos, concreto e asfalto;
  • Vivência com liderança de equipes será diferencial;
  • Perfil organizado, analítico e comprometido com qualidade.


Benefícios


  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo
  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte
  • Periculosidade
  • Parceria com instituição de ensino e idioma.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.

title: Assistente Comercial - Sdr
description:
A Monteiro & Lins Advocacia é um escritório referência em Direito Bancário para Pessoa Física e Empresarial , com atuação estratégica na recuperação financeira, reestruturação de dívidas e defesa de clientes em cenários de injustiça ou vulnerabilidade econômica.

Nossa missão é proporcionar segurança jurídica, estabilidade financeira e tranquilidade aos nossos clientes por meio de uma atuação técnica, humanizada e altamente profissional.


Estrutura Comercial


Nossa operação comercial é dividida em duas frentes principais:

1. Pré-atendimento – SDR

Responsável pelo primeiro contato com os leads, qualificação do caso, agendamento do diagnóstico jurídico e garantia de comparecimento às reuniões.

2. Atendimento – Closer

Responsável por acolher o cliente, compreender o cenário apresentado, apresentar o escritório e formalizar a proposta de prestação de serviços.


Responsabilidades do SDR

O(a) profissional atuará no time de pré-atendimento , sendo responsável por:

  • Realizar o primeiro contato com potenciais clientes;
  • Qualificar leads de forma estratégica;
  • Organizar e atualizar informações no CRM;
  • Garantir o comparecimento dos leads às reuniões agendadas;
  • Preencher e acompanhar as principais métricas da área;
  • Atuar em alinhamento com os fluxos e padrões do escritório.


Requisitos
  • Domínio completo da língua portuguesa (oral e escrita);
  • Perfil altamente comunicativo;
  • Facilidade e segurança para realizar ligações;
  • Organização, responsabilidade e foco em resultados;
  • Diferencial:
  • Estar cursando ou ter formação em Direito;
  • Ter experiência em escritórios de advocacia;
  • Conhecimento em CRM (preferencialmente Kommo );
  • Residir na cidade do Rio de Janeiro.

title: Cloud Architecture Consultant
description:
About You

You are a Cloud Architect who enjoys owning architectural decisions and designing secure, scalable, and compliant cloud solutions. You thrive in regulated environments and are comfortable balancing hands-on technical work with strategic thinking.   • Collaborate with engineering, security, and compliance teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory and technical standards.
  • Define and enforce security controls, including encryption, access management, and network protections.
  • Review and optimize existing AWS environments for performance, reliability, security, and cost-efficiency.
  • Document cloud architectures, technical decisions, and compliance-related considerations clearly and consistently.
  • Provide architectural leadership and technical guidance to development and infrastructure teams.
  • Support continuous improvement of cloud standards, patterns, and best practices across the organization.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Especialista Em Design De Calçados
description:
Especialista em Design de Calçados

Localização: Rio de Janeiro – RJ


I. A Missão da Posição

O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.


II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.
  • Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce.
  • Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio.
  • Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
  • Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.


III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.
  • Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
  • Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
  • Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.


IV. Diferenciais

  • Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
  • Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

Principais Responsabilidades

· Prospectar ativamente novos clientes, utilizando estratégias inbound e outbound;

· Mapear oportunidades junto a empresas dos mais diversos segmentos, entendendo suas necessidades de recrutamento e estrutura organizacional;

· Apresentar os serviços da consultoria;

· Conduzir reuniões comerciais, diagnósticos de necessidades e apresentações institucionais;

· Elaborar propostas comerciais com supervisão, negociações de contratos e acompanhamento até o fechamento;

· Atuar em parceria com o time de recrutamento para garantir alinhamento entre expectativa do cliente e entrega;

· Manter e atualizar o CRM;

· Acompanhar indicadores comerciais;

· Identificar tendências de mercado, movimentos da concorrência e novas oportunidades de serviços.


Requisitos

· Formação superior completa (Administração, RH, Psicologia, Gestão Comercial ou áreas correlatas);

· Experiência prévia em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em consultorias de Recrutamento e Seleção, RH ou serviços;

· Vivência com prospecção ativa e fechamento de contratos;

· Desejável conhecimento em processos de recrutamento, perfis profissionais e estruturas organizacionais;

· Habilidade de negociação, comunicação e relacionamento com stakeholders;

· Inglês Avançado.

title: Gerente De Operações
description:

  • Liderar equipesmultidisciplinares (soldagem, elétrica, refrigeração, mecânica, inspeção, NDT, estruturas, entre outras), promovendo engajamento, desenvolvimento e alta performance;
  • Gerenciar mobilizações, logística, materiais, equipamentos e certificações, garantindo prontidão operacional e compliance;
  • Assegurar a execução das atividades conforme procedimentos, desenhos, CTRs, normas técnicas e melhores práticas do setor;
  • Gerir equipes próprias e subcontratadas em atividades de construção, reparos, IMR e comissionamento;
  • Validar MTOs, garantindo aderência ao escopo, quantidades, especificações técnicas e rastreabilidade de materiais;
  • Monitorar progresso físico, produtividade e KPIs das frentes de trabalho, propondo ações corretivas quando necessário;
  • Garantir conformidade com as Normas NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35, requisitos IACS, ABS, DNV e exigências dos clientes;
  • Implementar planos de qualidade e inspeção, gerenciar NCRs, testes, inspeções e punch lists
  • Liderar análises de risco e HAZIDs, garantindo a aplicação de medidas de controle em campo
  • Atuar como ponto focal operacional junto ao cliente, assegurando alinhamento e comunicação eficaz;
  • Conduzir reuniões, auditorias e inspeções técnicas e operacionais;
  • Emitir relatórios semanais e mensais com indicadores de prazo, custo, QSMS, progresso e produtividade;
  • Registrar evolução de escopo, desvios e justificativas;
  • Conduzir sessões de lições aprendidas e implementar melhorias contínuas;
  • Manter alinhamento constante com a área Comercial quanto a impactos operacionais e execução conforme escopo contratado.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Naval, Elétrica, Produção, Petróleo ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 10 anos na área ou em função similar;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos EPC e IMR;
  • Vivência em projetos industriais, navais ou de óleo e gás;
  • Sólida experiência em planejamento, controle de custos, análise de produtividade e gestão de grandes equipes;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Conhecimento em metodologia EPC e gestão de projetos industriais;
  • Experiência comMS Project ou Primavera;
  • Conhecimento emERP (TOTVS/Fluig), plataformas de gestão de projetos e dashboards de BI;
  • Conhecimento das Normas NR-10, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35;
  • Conhecimento dos requisitos IACS, ABS e DNV.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência em projetos para a Petrobras;
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Microsoft Office (Word, Excel e PowerPoint);
  • Conhecimentos avançados em gestão e melhoria de processos.

title: Data Migration Specialist
description:
Data Engineer


Location: Brazil, Fully Remote

Type: Full-time (8 hours/day)

Setup: Consultancy / Freelance

Level: Senior-Mid Level

Industry: Software IT / SaaS

Shift: EST Time Zone

Equipment: Must have own machine;
equipment not provided



Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize data migration pipelines that enable seamless transitions from legacy systems into our SaaS platform. You will work closely with both customers and internal teams to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and long-term scalability across our product ecosystem.



Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement ETL/ELT pipelines to migrate customer data from various legacy systems into the SDL SaaS platform
  • Transform datasets across multiple formats (e.G., SQL databases, APIs, flat files like CSV) ensuring data integrity and consistency
  • Build reusable components and tooling that support repeatable and scalable migration processes
  • Automate data extraction, transformation, and loading workflows to improve performance and efficiency
  • Partner with customers and cross-functional teams to deeply understand data requirements and resolve data-related challenges
  • Apply best practices in code quality, testing, CI/CD, and deployment to maintain a robust engineering ecosystem
  • Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to evolving engineering standards as we scale
  • Support ongoing process improvement by helping build foundational data engineering capabilities



Job Requirements

  • Proven experience in data engineering , ETL development , or data migration within a SaaS environment
  • Proficiency in Python for data transformation and automation scripting
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of SQL and experience working with relational databases
  • Ability to work with multiple data formats (e.G., CSV, structured/unstructured sources)
  • Strong analytical mindset with high attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Knowledge of software development best practices, including version control and code reviews



Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GIS technologies and spatial data formats such as shapefiles
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure)
  • Experience building scalable data pipelines and automating complex workflows
  • Understanding of distributed systems or large-scale data processing architectures

title: Quality Analyst
description:
About us:


DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.


About the job:


The Quality Analiyst will support the Quality Assurance team in our MRO facility, specializing in landing gear maintenance, repair, and overhaul. Reporting directly to the Quality Assurance Manager, the Quality Auditor is responsible for performing audits, inspections, and assessments to ensure compliance with aviation regulations, internal procedures, and customer requirements.


Audit & Compliance:

  • Conduct scheduled and unscheduled internal audits in accordance with the Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards (e.G., FAA, EASA, ANAC).
  • Evaluate compliance of processes related to landing gear disassembly, inspection, repair, assembly, and testing.
  • Assist in preparing for and supporting external audits (regulatory and customer).

Inspection Oversight:

  • Review work orders, inspection records, and traceability documentation for accuracy and completeness.
  • Observe and assess maintenance activities for conformity to procedures and applicable standards.
  • Verify proper implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

Non-Conformance Management:

  • Identify and document non-conformances (NCRs) during audits or inspections.
  • Assist in root cause analysis and follow-up on corrective action implementation.
  • Track and report audit findings and trends to the Quality Assurance Manager.

Documentation & Records:

  • Maintain accurate records of audits, inspections, and findings.
  • Ensure all documentation complies with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
  • Participate in the continuous improvement of procedures and forms used in the QA function.

Training & Communication:

  • Support ongoing quality awareness and training initiatives within the facility.
  • Communicate findings professionally and constructively to relevant departments and personnel.
  • Control technical training and training documentation for regulatory agencies and documents
  • Promote a culture of safety, quality, and compliance.


Work Experience:

Minimum 3 years of experience in MRO, preferably with aviation.

Experience in auditing, inspection, or quality control in an FAA or EASA-regulated environment.


Educational:

High school diploma or GED required;
associate or bachelor'sdegree in Aviation Maintenance, Quality, or Engineering is a plus.

Technical Skills:

Working knowledge of aviation quality standards and regulatory requirements.


Soft Skills:

Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

Effective written and verbal communication.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office and QMS-related software systems.

Ability to work independently and maintain objectivity in audits.


Full Time in Galeão - RJ.

Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.

title: Senior full stack developer
description:

Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties:
You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.
Key Responsibilities: Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards. Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery. Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders. Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality. Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools. Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly. Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture. Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals. Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems. Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.
Qualifications: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field. Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects. Stack: Backend (Java, Python and. Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures. Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability. Quality & Dev Ops: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments. Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing). Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
Spanish proficiency.
Ia C (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.

This role will require a high level of attention to detail, an understanding of the aerospace industry, and the ability to work effectively with vendors, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of materials, components, and parts for maintenance and repair services.
Detailed Description
Procurement of Materials & Parts:
Source and purchase materials, components, and parts required for landing gear MRO operations.
Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, lead times, and reliability.
Ensure all purchases meet the required specifications and are compliant with industry standards and regulations (e.g., FAA, EASA).
Inventory Management:
Assist in the maintenance of optimal inventory levels with warehouse team to support continuous MRO operations while minimizing excess stock and potential obsolescence.
Help warehouse team if necessary, in the tracking and monitoring of the stock usage, reordering materials and components as necessary.
Supplier Relationship Management:
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers and vendors to ensure high-quality products and timely deliveries.
Negotiate pricing, terms, and conditions with suppliers to ensure competitive sourcing and cost savings.
Quality Assurance & Compliance:
Work closely with the quality control and engineering teams to ensure that all materials and parts purchased meet the required standards for safety and performance.
Monitor and address any quality issues, returns, or discrepancies with suppliers.
Data Entry & Reporting:
Maintain accurate records of all purchasing transactions, including purchase orders, invoices, and delivery schedules.
Prepare regular procurement reports to track spending, inventory levels, and supplier performance.
Collaboration & Cross-functional Support:
Collaborate with maintenance, engineering, and other departments to identify material needs and ensure procurement aligns with operational requirements.
Provide support to project teams by ensuring the timely availability of materials for scheduled landing gear maintenance projects.
Cost Control:
Monitor and control procurement costs to meet budget targets and contribute to cost-saving initiatives.
Identify opportunities for process improvements and cost efficiencies in procurement activities.
Qualification Minimum Requirements
Work Experience:
At least 3-5 years of experience in procurement or purchasing, ideally in an aerospace, MRO, or manufacturing environment.
Knowledge of landing gear systems, aerospace components, and regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA) is a significant advantage
Educational:
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Business, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field preferred.
Fluent/advanced English
Technical Skills:
Proficient in procurement software and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, etc.).
Knowledge of inventory management systems and ERP tools is a plus. (Oracle and quantum)
Soft Skills:
Strong negotiation and communication skills.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.
A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.
Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.
E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

We are seeking an ambitious and results-driven Business Development Manager specialized in engineering services to join our team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This role is essential for expanding our footprint in the engineering sector, driving new client acquisition, and strengthening strategic partnerships across Brazil’s key industries such as oil & gas, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and construction.
You will focus on selling a range of engineering solutions including design, consulting, project management, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), technical staffing, and specialized engineering services. If you have a strong network in Brazil’s engineering ecosystem and a proven ability to win complex, high-value contracts, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in our growth in one of Latin America’s most dynamic markets.

Identify and develop new business opportunities in the engineering services sector across Brazil, with a primary focus on Rio de Janeiro and surrounding regions.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.
5+ years of experience in B2 B business development or sales within the engineering services sector (consulting, design, EPC, technical outsourcing, etc.). Proven track record of winning and closing high-value engineering contracts (ideally > R$1 M).
Strong existing network in Brazil’s engineering market, particularly in Rio de Janeiro (oil & gas, energy, infrastructure sectors highly desirable).
Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a bonus). Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
Familiarity with public and private tender processes in Brazil

Ability to understand technical engineering requirements and translate them into commercial value propositions.
Self-starter with strong hunter mentality, capable of working independently in a target-driven environment.

title: Senior staff reservoir simulation engineer
description:
Position Summary
CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.
CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.
Essential Responsibilities
The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.
The successful candidate will:
Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.
The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.
Education
Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.
Knowledge & Skills
This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, Power Point).
All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
Experience Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.
No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!
We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.

I. A Missão da Posição
O Especialista de Design (Lifestyle) é o responsável estratégico por traduzir conceitos e ideias criativas em produtos técnicos viáveis e desejáveis. Atuando como o braço técnico da área de Estilo, sua missão é transformar os direcionamentos estéticos em especificações precisas, garantindo que a identidade da marca de Athleisure seja preservada desde o desenho inicial até o produto acabado. II. Responsabilidades Principais Tradução e Desenvolvimento Técnico: Converter conceitos criativos e temas propostos pelo Estilista em desenhos técnicos, modelagens e acabamentos detalhados para as coleções. Guardião da Consistência Criativa: Zelar pela qualidade técnica e consistência estética das coleções, garantindo que o produto final reflita fielmente a identidade visual da marca.

Formação: Graduação em Moda, Design de Moda, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência em traduzir coleções de alta escala e múltiplas entradas sazonais.
Vivência em marcas de moda lifestyle que exijam alto nível de detalhamento técnico.
Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica dentro do time de estilo para viabilização de novos produtos.
